headline: Unthinkable... "This will ruin Korean companies" unprecedented event: travel platform loses 'No. 1' to China
summary: Chinese online travel agency Trip.com has overtaken domestic Korean OTAs in monthly active users, backed by a volume offensive. Korean industry players warn of a survival crisis for local platforms.
why: Trip.com is a large Chinese online travel platform, and competition from it affects the revenue of local booking services in Korea.
